name: The Ballad of the Birds of Satan

podcast.body: This 10-minute epic song served as the introduction for Taylor Hawkins' side project, The Birds of Satan, which formed in 2014. The band was characterized by its very prog rock sound, and the track featured appearances by Dave Grohl, Pat Smear, and Rami Jaffee. "a very prog rock band that introduced itself with a 10-minute epic song entitled The Ballad of the Birds of Satan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
